stages.title: Ambush at the Waystone
stages.objective: Defeat the raiders and keep {warden} alive

start: warden|To me! {enemy} on the road, and more coming out of the brush. I can't hold them alone!
progress: warden|Keep them off me! Watch the flanks!
warden|Almost there. Don't let a single one through!
success: warden|That's the last of them. Look at these tracks... they came from {place}.
warden|They didn't stumble on this road. Someone sent them. Follow me, and stay close.
failure: notice|{warden} has fallen. The raiders hold {road}.
boss|The road is ours. Leave the body where the Daevas can see it.

start: notice|The raiders hold {road}. Take it back!
bots|They got the Warden. We make them pay for that!
progress: bots|Push them back to the treeline!
success: notice|The road is clear. Their trail leads {place}.
bots|No Warden to guide us. We find that camp ourselves.
failure: notice|The raiders keep {road}. Travellers will have to find another way.

start: warden|Quietly now. The camp should be {place}.
progress: warden|More of them. They know we're coming.
success: warden|There. Their camp. Those are no common thugs at the fires.
notice|You have found the raider camp.
failure: notice|The escort failed. Horns sound from the raider camp {place}.
boss|Daevas on the road! To arms, all of you!

start: warden|Take down their lieutenants. Without them the rest will scatter.
progress: boss|You think you can walk into my camp? I'll come for you myself.
success: warden|Their lieutenants are down. Listen... something big is coming.
boss|Enough! I will finish this with my own hands!
failure: notice|The camp holds. The raiders will return to the road.
warden|Fall back! We regroup and come back stronger.

start: notice|The camp was warned. Its lieutenants are waiting.
bots|They saw us coming. Shields up!
progress: bots|One of their officers is down!
boss|Keep them busy. I'm almost ready.
success: boss|Useless, all of you! I will do it myself!
failure: notice|The camp holds. The raiders will return to the road.

start: boss|You broke my camp. Now I break you.
phase: boss|Is that all? Guards, to me!
boss|You bleed me? Then bleed with me! Come, my blades!
boss|I will not fall to road wardens and wanderers! To me, all of you!
success: notice|{boss} has been defeated! {road} is safe again.
warden|It's over. The road is ours. Every traveller here owes you, and so do I.
failure: boss|Another day, Daevas. The road will be mine.
